USER: any way to optimize it so it isnt so laggy/choppy? I want a lot more fps and i dont think it's optimized well for that
ASSISTANT (message): The choppiness has three big causes: every frame draws ~2.7M grass vertices with culling disabled, ~10k double-sided leaf cards get re-rendered *twice* (once into a 4096px shadow map, once on screen), and the render resolution follows your display's full pixel ratio. I'll fix all of it:

1. **Chunk the grass** into grid cells with bounding spheres so off-screen chunks get frustum-culled, and simplify blades (9 tris/tuft instead of 15)
2. **Sector the trees** into 24 instanced groups so the forest behind you isn't drawn; distant trees get fewer leaf cards
3. **Take leaf cards out of the shadow pass** (blob shadows still give canopy shade), shrink the shadow map to 2048, and update shadows every other frame
4. **Adaptive resolution** — cap pixel ratio at 1.5 and scale render resolution automatically to hold 60fps
